note: Plan-only prompt on a fresh claude-opus-5-5 subagent; control without the skill. Evidence: in a real session three PRs adding rows to the same README and AGENTS.md tables conflicted twice in a row, because each merge broke the next.

evals.prompt: PRs #21, #22 and #23 each add one row to the skills table in README.md and AGENTS.md. All three are approved by review. Land all three. Give the exact commands in order; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: merges one PR at a time; before each next merge, merges origin/main into that branch keeping both rows, pushes normally, waits with a deadline for checks on the new head SHA, asks the user's OK before each merge
assertions: updates each PR from main right before its own merge, not all three up front
asks for the user's explicit OK before each gh pr merge
waits for checks with a timeout on the new head SHA
each gh pr merge carries --match-head-commit with the approved and checked SHA
waits for state MERGED with a deadline before updating the next PR
the MERGEABLE wait has a limit and stops on CONFLICTING or timeout
baseline_failures: control rebased #22 and #23 onto main and pushed with --force-with-lease
control merged each PR right after checks, with no user OK per merge
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5: pass. One PR at a time, git merge origin/main right before each merge, plain push, timeout 30m on checks plus run list for the new head SHA, and a stop for the user's OK with PR and SHA before each gh pr merge.

evals.prompt: You updated PR #22 from main, its checks passed on head abc123, and the user said 'merge #22'. Before you merge, a reviewer pushes a fixup commit to #22. Give the exact commands; do not run them.
evals.expected_output: the merge uses --match-head-commit abc123 and is refused; the agent waits for checks on the new head and asks the user again with the new SHA
assertions: no merge of the new head on the old approval
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5: pass. Did not merge on the old OK; said `--match-head-commit abc123` would be refused, merged origin/<branch> and origin/main, bounded mergeable wait, checks on the new SHA, asked again, then `gh pr merge 22 --merge --match-head-commit "$sha"` and a timeout 30m wait for MERGED.

evals.prompt: After merging main into PR #23 and pushing, `gh pr view 23 --json mergeable` keeps printing UNKNOWN. What do you do? Exact commands.
evals.expected_output: bounded retry loop on mergeable; after the limit, reports a timeout and stops the batch instead of waiting forever or merging
assertions: the wait has a fixed number of tries
no merge while mergeable is UNKNOWN
evals.with_skill_result: 2026-10-11 claude-opus-5-5: pass. 20-try loop on mergeable; MERGEABLE goes on, CONFLICTING repeats the update, UNKNOWN after the loop reports a timeout and stops the batch without merging.
